notes: Early start, 6:15am arrival. Big warbler morning, twelve species in the gardens before the crowds showed up. Left by 9:30 when it got busy.
Went midday on a Saturday. Packed with people, birds were quiet, and the West Pond trail was shoulder to shoulder. Should have gone early.
Timed it to the falling tide. Good shorebird numbers on the exposed flats. Quiet, almost nobody there.
High tide the whole window, no flats exposed, nothing to look at. Hot and buggy. Wasted trip.
Grassland edges were decent, a few sparrows and a kestrel. Wind was strong which kept passerines down.
Convenient and easy to get to, but heavily birded. Decent migrants, though I was following other people around rather than finding my own.
Good birds but very crowded even at 7am. Hard to enjoy with that many people on the paths.
Cool and clear, great light for photos. Long walk, took the bus over. Almost no one on the shore trail.
Too hot, humid, no shade on the exposed sections. Ran out of water. Bad idea in July.
Long transit to get there but worth it. Cold, clear, quiet. Would go again outside peak season.
Nice grounds, went on a weekday evening so it was calm. Would avoid weekends here.
Ferry line was long and the island was packed. The art installations were good but the logistics ate half the day.
Food was great, but very crowded and loud. Fun once, not something I'd repeat often.
Went for the fossil halls on a cold weekday. Quiet, could actually spend time at each case. Excellent.
Holiday week, mobbed with families. Couldn't get near the exhibits I wanted. Left early.
Good exhibit, though large galleries get tiring. Better in shorter visits.
Small enough to do properly in two hours. Easy subway ride, low crowds on a Sunday morning.
Underrated spot. Good migrants and far fewer people than Prospect. Gates open late though, so no dawn access.
Early again, 6am. Strong migration overnight and it showed. Confirms that early plus good radar the night before is the pattern that works here.
Fine but unremarkable. Close by and easy, though the trails are noisy from the highway. Good filler, not a destination.
